business_problem: Meixinda had already built a basic energy-management system, but it still needed deeper data integration, more intelligent scheduling, and less dependence on manual expertise to improve delivery, quality, staffing, and energy efficiency across textile operations.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud supplied Meixinda with an AIoT manufacturing stack that spans scheduling, energy management, IoT data integration, and visual quality control. APS intelligent scheduling standardizes workflows and business rules so production plans can be optimized and adjusted visually rather than by manual experience alone. The 'Duneng' energy-management application digitizes energy and quality data, links them to enterprise equipment and meter hierarchies, and feeds analytics back into production decisions. On the shop floor, the Tiangong IoT platform supports an intelligent fabric-inspection system and a color-difference management system: defects are detected online, inspection reports are generated automatically, and batch-head color variation is identified so re-dyeing and rework can be reduced. Together, these layers connect device data, planning logic, energy control, and quality inspection in one operating model, helping Meixinda turn tribal process knowledge into reusable digital manufacturing capability.

solution_components.name: APS Intelligent Scheduling
solution_components.role: Optimizes production planning and applies visual scheduling logic to improve delivery and throughput.

solution_components.name: Duneng Energy Management Application
solution_components.role: Collects and analyzes energy and quality data so operating and cost decisions can be tied back to production conditions.

solution_components.name: Tiangong IoT Platform
solution_components.role: Connects shop-floor systems and provides the integration layer for Meixinda's inspection and reporting applications.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Fabric Inspection System
solution_components.role: Detects defects on the production line and generates standardized inspection data and reports automatically.

solution_components.name: Color Difference Management System
solution_components.role: Identifies batch-head color variation to improve first-pass quality and reduce dye rework.

data_flow: Production orders are optimized in APS scheduling, while shop-floor energy and quality signals flow into the Duneng application for monitoring and analysis. Fabric and color-difference inspection data is captured through the Tiangong IoT-connected systems, turned into reports, and then fed back into management and process adjustments so planning, energy use, and quality control stay linked.
business_outcome: Meixinda improved scheduling discipline, increased energy-management depth, automated parts of visual quality control, and converted expert-driven textile know-how into a more repeatable digital operating model.
architecture_clues: The deployment links scheduling, energy analytics, IoT connectivity, defect inspection, and color-difference management instead of solving each problem separately.
Inspection outputs are automatically reported and can be accessed both locally and online.
One explicit goal was to turn worker experience and manual knowledge into full-process digital data.
